description: a lean young woman master archer with long black hair in a high ponytail and a silver diadem with a green gem, a calm pretty young woman's face in clean profile with one eye, a small straight nose and closed lips, elegant black leather armour with silver plates and silver filigree, a silver pauldron shaped like a hawk's wing, a long dark green cloak hanging behind, black leggings and tall black boots, one long black recurve bow with silver tips strapped upright on the back behind the shoulder, the whole bow above the waist and behind the body, never in front of the legs, nothing in the hands, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing and walking to the right, the nose pointing right and only one eye showing, the chest, belly and hips turned fully to the right and not towards the viewer, only the near arm showing, hanging relaxed beside the body with an empty loosely closed hand, the far arm hidden behind the body, the back and shoulders straight and upright, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy
